title: SynthetixCorpusManifestSample
description: JSON Schema for Synthetix AI Detector benchmark dataset samples

text.description: The full body of text to be analyzed by the detector

label.description: Ground truth label: 'human' for human-written text, 'ai' for AI-generated text

source.description: Origin dataset, corpus collection name, or author tag

fixture_family.description: Style template of the synthetic regression fixture (not genuine provider output)

word_count.description: Number of words in the text sample

language.description: ISO language code of the text sample
